command:
export LBL=m8g
set +e
set -uo pipefail
# spawn runs task commands under bash -e; `set -uo pipefail` does not clear it (spawn#707).
export PATH=/opt/conda/bin:$PATH TMPDIR=/tmp HOME=/tmp
cd /tmp
sha256sum -c data.sha256 || { echo "FAIL: staged GHCN bytes do not match their pins"; exit 1; }
sha256sum -c pins.sha256 || { echo "FAIL: the workload script does not match its pin"; exit 1; }
CG=/sys/fs/cgroup
sample(){ : > /tmp/samp.tsv
  while :; do printf '%s\t%s\t%s\n' "$(date +%s)" "$(cat $CG/memory.current 2>/dev/null || echo 0)" \
    "$(awk '/^usage_usec/{print $2}' $CG/cpu.stat 2>/dev/null || echo 0)" >> /tmp/samp.tsv; sleep 1; done; }
sample & SP=$!
T0=$(date +%s)
python3 -u ghcn_workload.py 2024.csv ghcnd-stations.txt "$LBL" > workload-$LBL.log 2>&1
RC=$?
WALL=$(( $(date +%s) - T0 ))
kill $SP 2>/dev/null
cat workload-$LBL.log
PEAK=$(cat $CG/memory.peak 2>/dev/null || awk -F'\t' '{if($2+0>m)m=$2+0} END{print m}' /tmp/samp.tsv)
CORES=$(awk -F'\t' 'NR==1{u=$3;t=$1} END{if($1>t) printf "%.2f", ($3-u)/1e6/($1-t); else print "na"}' /tmp/samp.tsv)
{ printf 'label\t%s\n' "$LBL"; printf 'arch\t%s\n' "$(uname -m)"; printf 'nproc\t%s\n' "$(nproc)"
  printf 'workload_wall_s\t%s\n' "$WALL"; printf 'workload_exit\t%s\n' "$RC"
  printf 'cgroup_peak_gib\t%s\n' "$(awk -v p="$PEAK" 'BEGIN{printf "%.2f", p/1073741824}')"
  printf 'avg_cores\t%s\n' "$CORES"; } | tee size-$LBL.txt
test "$RC" = 0 || { echo "FAIL: a workload check failed (exit $RC)"; exit 1; }
grep -q "^checks_failed	0$" result-$LBL.txt || { echo "FAIL: result file does not report 0 failed checks"; exit 1; }
echo "SMOKE CHECK PASSED"
